solution:
Using $(\alpha+\beta)^2=\alpha^2+\beta^2+2\alpha\beta$,
$$ (\alpha+\beta)^2=7+2(3)=13,\qquad \alpha+\beta=\sqrt{13} $$
The monic quadratic is $x^2-(\alpha+\beta)x+\alpha\beta=0$, hence $x^2-\sqrt{13}x+3=0$.
